title: dillenia membranifolia
intro: Dillenia membranifolia, commonly known as the 'White Butter Tree' or 'Butter Tree', is a plant species belonging to the Dilleniaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Dillenia membranifolia include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
